android.desc:
Turn your smartphone into a real digital Swiss Army knife. Tooliz brings together 45+ everyday tools in one light, modern and free app. No more installing one app for the bubble level, another for QR codes and a third for the timer!

🆕 NEW IN 3.10
• New IT category: subnet calculator, port list, public DNS servers, command cheat sheet (PowerShell, CMD, Linux, Git…)
• Add up durations (episodes, playlists, courses) and get the end time
• 160+ currencies in the converter, even offline
• Your favorite cities in time zones
• Improved batch file renaming

🛠️ DIY & MEASURING
• Bubble level (1D and 2D), ruler, augmented-reality protractor
• Compass that shows places around you
• Metal detector, seismometer, light meter (lux)
• GPS speedometer with map

📷 CAMERA & VISUAL
• On-device text scanner (OCR), QR code reader and generator
• Magnifier, mirror, color picker (HEX/RGB), light box
• Flashlight (strobe, SOS, Morse)

📂 FILES & PDF
• Document scanner, image → PDF, text → PDF, merge, split and compress PDFs
• Images: compress, convert, crop, resize
• Batch rename, file info, checksum (hash), text encryption

💻 IT & SYSTEM
• Subnet calculator, port list, public DNS, command cheat sheet
• Network tools (local and public IP, ping), device info, task manager
• Read and write NFC tags, code editor

🧮 CALCULATE
• Calculator, unit and currency converter, date and duration calculator, tip and bill splitter

✍️ PRODUCTIVITY
• Notepad, translator, spell checker (9 languages), password generator with vault, tally counter, random decider

⏱️ TIME & WELLBEING
• Stopwatch and timer, Pomodoro, sport (GPS cardio and HIIT), world clock, breathing exercises

🎵 AUDIO
• Sound meter (dB), tuner, metronome, tone generator, soundboard

WHY TOOLIZ?
✅ All-in-one: 45+ tools in a single lightweight app
✅ Simple and respectful: no account, most tools work offline, and permissions are only requested when a tool needs them
✅ Polished Material 3 design, dark mode, favorites to pin your go-to tools
✅ Free, with a one-time "Zero Ads" option
✅ Made by an indie developer in Paris who listens to his Discord community

Download Tooliz and free up space on your phone!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Tooliz – An offline-first mobile toolkit built with Flutter (Radial UI)

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I’m the developer behind Tooliz. I built this because I was frustrated with the current state of utility apps on the Play Store—most are either 100MB+ bloatware, require unnecessary permissions (like contacts/location for a flashlight), or force full-screen video ads just to use a simple ruler.

I wanted to build a single, lightweight app that respects the user and focuses on UI/UX efficiency.

The Tech Stack: It’s built with Flutter. I chose it to handle the custom painting required for the tools smoothly at 60fps+ on both Android and iOS.

Interesting Technical Challenges:

The Radial Menu: I didn't want a standard grid or drawer. I implemented a custom Radial Menu using CustomPainter and heavy trigonometry to handle the touch hit-testing and animations. It feels much faster for thumb navigation than reaching for a top-left hamburger menu.

Sensor Fusion & Hardware:

Metal Detector: Accesses the raw magnetometer stream (sensors_plus package). I had to implement a calibration step to filter out the background magnetic field and isolate local anomalies (metals).

Sound Meter: Uses the microphone stream to calculate decibels. Mapping the raw PCM data to accurate dB SPL values across different device microphones was... painful. I used a calibration offset system to mitigate hardware variance.

Offline-First Architecture: Except for a minimal ad banner (to keep the project alive), everything works offline. For the Unit Converter, I hardcoded the conversion logic …
